description: If a theory \(\Gamma\) on atoms indexed by \(\mathbb N\) is finitely satisfiable, there is a surviving binary assignment of every length \(n\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.prefix_level_nonempty
  (Γ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.Theory ℕ)
  (hfin : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.FiniteSatisfiable Γ) (n : ℕ) :
  ∃ r, Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.PrefixSurvives Γ n r
